retrievalProfile.description: A high-impact 1960s album aesthetic featuring an extreme close-up of a shouting vocalist against a flat, saturated red field with bold stencil-style display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a vibrant red background, featuring a low-angle, extreme close-up of a man's face in mid-shout, oriented diagonally from the bottom left. The top third contains a horizontal band of bold, white, stencil-like display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's open mouth acts as a secondary focal point to the eyes
Diagonal orientation of the head creates dynamic tension against the horizontal text
High-contrast lighting on the face pops against the flat red field
Textual header acts as a visual weight balancing the heavy dark hair at the bottom
coreInvariants: Bold white stencil-style display type at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The head is positioned in the lower two-thirds, scaled to fill the width, tilted back at a 45-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open mouth and teeth of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white text at the top, follow the diagonal line of the nose down to the open mouth, and rest on the dark texture of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat red in the upper corners and around the profile of the face.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for all typography and highlights in the teeth
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the hair and shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the skin tones and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif with stencil cuts
letterConstructionRules: Diagonal stencil gaps appear in the middle of vertical stems
Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and W feature sharp, deep valleys
H and I are constructed from thick vertical blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large stencil display type paired with smaller, stacked sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Stereo indicator arrows at the very top
Small logo block in the bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric stencil aesthetic and heavy weight.
Captures the mid-century modern stencil feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, low-angle photograph of a man with dark hair shouting with his mouth wide open, set against a solid, vibrant red background. The lighting should be harsh, emphasizing facial texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, white, stencil-style display title across the top third of the image, underlined by a thin white rule. Include a small 'STEREO' graphic with arrows at the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Is the subject's head tilted at a sharp diagonal?
Is the typography white and stencil-like?
Is there a thin horizontal line separating the text from the image?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red is not washed out or orange-leaning
Check that the stencil cuts in the text are clearly visible
Verify the diagonal composition of the head feels dynamic
Confirm the white text is perfectly legible against the red
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated Color Field + Extreme Diagonal Portrait + Stencil Header
